title: Grateful Dead Live at Boston Music Hall on 1972-09-16
lineage: Both sources were downloaded FLACs/SHNs > WAV > Vegas 5 > WAV > CD Wave > FLAC 16 (level 8)

ai_review.summary: A scorching 1972 show captured in an excellent matrix mix, highlighted by a legendary Dark Star.
ai_review.review: The performance is consistently praised as hot and superb, with Dark Star (and its segue into Brokedown Palace) singled out as one of the band’s finest Type‑II jams. The matrix blend of soundboard and audience delivers a crystal‑clear, in‑the‑room feel that most listeners love, though a single reviewer disliked the audience ambience.

ai_rating.rationale: Nearly all reviewers (6 of 7) give 4‑5 stars and rave about both the musical energy and the top‑notch matrix recording; only one low rating mentions a minor audience‑noise issue, so overall rating is high with strong consensus.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Balanced matrix blend of soundboard and audience gives an ‘in the room’ feel; reviewers describe it as crystal‑clear, superbly mixed, and far superior to pure soundboard recordings. One reviewer noted a dislike for audience noise, but this was isolated.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set maintains high energy throughout, with Dark Star leading into Brokedown Palace and keeping the momentum strong; reviewers describe the whole concert as consistently fantastic.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His guitar is repeatedly praised – described as growling, elegant, spacey and superb, especially during Dark Star.
